spec.target: original CSV net_without_funding <= per-type train q20
spec.train: Binance entry<2023-01-01 AND exit<2023-01-01; only mature labels
spec.test: Binance entry>=2023-01-01; direction and ranking frozen from train
spec.orientation: risk higher if train raw AUC>=0.5; otherwise lower; no test flip
spec.coverage: exact UTC endpoints; ER24 all25 closes, high/low/flow full 4/24 hourly observations; volume baseline >=648/720 prior rolling4h observations
spec.volume_baseline: median of past 720 rolling4h volumes, current observation excluded
spec.CI: 999 resamples of active entry-month clusters, exploratory 95% percentile intervals; >=25 finite observations and both classes
spec.prefix_check: recompute raw/green input prefix at five selected case entries
spec.novelty_limit: Working specification fixed before this run; original outcomes and existing matched pairs were already inspected. Not an untouched holdout or historical preregistration.

limitations: 32 exploratory comparisons, CIs not multiplicity or selection adjusted
Entry-month cluster intervals are descriptive, not paired equity block bootstrap
No policy, multivariate model, new thresholds, or OOS feature flip fitted
Original 2023+ history and selected cases were already inspected; these are not new independent validations
News, OI and futures orderflow absent from these eight axes; volume does not establish a news cause
Known-time is assigned closed-hour time; vendor revisions and live availability not reconstructed
